build_EM_quantizer: build a python module that uses the EM class to quantize a weight matrix with k-means clustering
run_EM_step: run a single EM algorithm iteration on a weight matrix to update centroids and assignments
create_EM_centroids: create and initialize centroids by sampling random columns from a weight matrix W
save_EM_results: save EM centroids, assignments, and objective values to disk for a given layer
load_EM_centroids: load previously saved EM centroids and assignments from disk for a given layer
